worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.summary: You have to get close first: nuzzle an electrified cheek against the target for tiny damage, but it always paralyses. A whiff does nothing at all. Pounce mode reaches further, at the cost of a slower landing and a lighter nuzzle. Electric types are immune to paralysis.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.description.0: Nuzzle power %1$s (physical), needing contact within %2$s blocks; starting distance %3$s, then the caster pounces and must actually reach the target.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.description.1: The pounce covers up to %1$s blocks; on contact the target is paralysed for %2$s with %3$s arcs clinging to it; electric types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.description.2: Windup %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s; a whiff deals nothing but still costs the cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.pounce.on: Pounce mode: lunge x1.35, starting distance x1.3, +2 windup, recovery x1.35 and nuzzle power x0.9, to catch a target running further away.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.pounce.off: Short nuzzle: a faster windup and recovery and x1.05 nuzzle power, at the cost of having to get closer.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.growth.0: From level %1$s the nuzzle power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.growth.1: From level %1$s the paralysis lasts %2$s and the lunge reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.use.1: Catch a fleeing target and pin it
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.use.2: Open on a troublesome target with a guaranteed paralysis
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.preference.poun: On: lunge x1.35 and starting distance x1.3 to catch a target running further away, but +2 windup, recovery x1.35 and nuzzle power x0.9. Off: a short nuzzle with a faster windup and recovery and x1.05 power, but you must get closer.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.preference.ai.m: Only within this distance does it consider the target for a pounce, then shared approach logic brings the body into contact range; since its range is at the face, a larger value starts the chase sooner.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.preference.ai.s: When on, a target already paralysed is not a candidate - the guaranteed paralysis would be wasted; when off, it nuzzles regardless.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.preference.ai.p: When on, a fast-moving target gets higher priority so the runner is caught and pinned; when off, all threats rank the same.
worldcombat.skill.nuzzle.preference.ai.l: When on, the companion may leave its post to nuzzle; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
world_combat.move.nuzzle.text.immune: Electric typing shrugged off the paralysis
